query_analysis.original_query: Our centrifuge is showing reduced separation efficiency when processing a slurry with fine solids. Could this be caused by feed rate fluctuations?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the potential impact of feed rate fluctuations on the reduced separation efficiency of a centrifuge processing a slurry containing fine solids.

selected_agents.role: Root cause analysis of centrifuge performance issues
Analysis of feed rate fluctuations and their impact on separation efficiency

communication_strategy.information_flow: Diagnostic information exchange and hypothesis testing
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative problem solving and integrated analysis

clarification_questions: What is the typical particle size distribution of the fine solids in the slurry?
What is the current feed rate and what is the range of fluctuations observed?
Have there been any recent changes in the slurry composition or centrifuge operating conditions?
